pairs.target: cìrì wǔhòu , tǎ wéi dào mù chǎng hòutou de xiǎoyuàn shí , xiān tīngjiàn wūlǐ yǒu rénshǔ qián , shǔ dào dìwǔméi , yòu cóngtóulái le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: The next afternoon, when Tavi reached the little courtyard behind the timber yard, he first heard someone counting money inside; at the fifth coin, they started over once more.
pairs.hanzi: 次日午后，塔维到木场后头的小院时，先听见屋里有人数钱，数到第五枚，又从头来了一遍。

pairs.target: huò chéng réng zuòzài chuángbiān , yòutuǐ diàngāo , miànqián gēzhe yíkuài jièlái de kuān bǎn , bǎn shàng héng zhe sānshù lǐ qí de jiù shéng , shī ní yǐjīng bújiàn le .
pairs.english: Huo Cheng was still sitting at the bedside, his right leg raised; a borrowed wide board lay in front of him, three neat bundles of old rope across it, and the wet mud now gone.
pairs.hanzi: 霍成仍坐在床边，右腿垫高，面前搁着一块借来的宽板，板上横着三束理齐的旧绳，湿泥已经不见了。

pairs.target: qīzi jiāngmén zhī zhù , jiào tǎ wéi zǒu mànxiē , tā kuàguò ménkǎn , méi qù dūn chuáng qián , xiān bǎ kàoqiáng de dèng lā dào bù dǎnglù de dìfāng .
pairs.english: His wife propped the door open, telling Tavi to walk slowly; he stepped over the threshold without crouching before the bed, first pulling the stool by the wall into a place out of the way.
pairs.hanzi: 妻子将门支住，叫塔维走慢些，他跨过门槛，没去蹲床前，先把靠墙的凳拉到不挡路的地方。

pairs.target: mù chǎng de huǒjì ná qǐ yíshù , wèn zěnme háiyǒu duǎn de , huò chéng shuō duàntóu yǐjīng jiǎn chūlái , méi ná tā tóng chángshéng zhāchéng yíshù hùnòngrén .
pairs.english: The timber yard's worker picked up one bundle, asking why there were still short lengths; Huo Cheng said the broken ends had already been cut out, and he had not bundled them with long rope into a single bundle to deceive anyone.
pairs.hanzi: 木场的伙计拿起一束，问怎么还有短的，霍成说断头已经剪出来，没拿它同长绳扎成一束糊弄人。

pairs.target: " yuánlái nà bàn kǔn ne ? "
pairs.english: “What about that half-bundle from before?”
pairs.hanzi: “原来那半捆呢？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn wán , nǚrén zhǐxiàng ménwài , shuō tuìhuíqù le , zhèhuí zhǐ sòng gān de , xiān shì yìkǔn , làn tóu yě bùzhǔn zài yā zài dǐxià .
pairs.english: After Tavi asked, the woman pointed outside, saying it had been returned; this time they sent only dry rope, one bundle as a trial first, and rotten ends must not be buried underneath again either.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问完，女人指向门外，说退回去了，这回只送干的，先试一捆，烂头也不准再压在底下。

pairs.target: huǒjì shuō zhèyàng tiāo , shèngxià de dāngrán shǎo , huò chéng jiāng zuì xì de nàgēn chōuchūlái , méi lā gěi tā kàn , zhǐ bǎ huībái de yíduàn dì dào tā yǎnqián .
pairs.english: The worker said picking through like this would naturally leave less; Huo Cheng drew out the thinnest strand, without pulling it to demonstrate to him, only offering the grey-white section before his eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 伙计说这样挑，剩下的当然少，霍成将最细的那根抽出来，没拉给他看，只把灰白的一段递到他眼前。

pairs.target: zhègēn ruò suànjìnqù , rén náhuíqù kǔn huò , duàn shí kěbú wèn shì sòng shéng de rén háishì lǐ shéng de rén shuō tā hǎo , huò chéng yào tā dāngmiàn fēnqīng , bié huítóu yòu àn zhěngkǔn suàn .
pairs.english: If this strand counted, someone would take it home to tie goods; when it broke, it would not ask whether the person who delivered rope or the person who sorted it had called it good; Huo Cheng wanted him to distinguish that face to face, rather than later count everything as a whole bundle again.
pairs.hanzi: 这根若算进去，人拿回去捆货，断时可不问是送绳的人还是理绳的人说它好，霍成要他当面分清，别回头又按整捆算。

pairs.target: huǒjì dūnxià kàn le yíhuìer , jiāng nàgēn ná kāi , shuō zhè yìkǔn zhàoshuō hǎo de liùméi fù , wǎnghòu sònglái zhīqián xiān kàn , bùnéng lǐwán cái jiào rén tiāo yíbiàn .
pairs.english: The worker crouched and looked a while, moved that strand aside, and said this bundle would be paid at the agreed six coins; future deliveries should be checked beforehand, rather than making someone sort everything through once after the work was done.
pairs.hanzi: 伙计蹲下看了一会儿，将那根拿开，说这一捆照说好的六枚付，往后送来之前先看，不能理完才叫人挑一遍。

pairs.target: huò chéng shuō láishí liǎnggè rén yìqǐ kàn , ruò sònglái de búshì jīnrì zhèbān , zìjǐ kěyǐ bù jiē , búshì zhǐyào gē dào ménkǒu jiùsuàn qiànxià yírì huó .
pairs.english: Huo Cheng said both people would inspect together on arrival; if a delivery was unlike today's batch, he could refuse it; just leaving it at the door did not mean he owed them a day's work.
pairs.hanzi: 霍成说来时两个人一起看，若送来的不是今日这般，自己可以不接，不是只要搁到门口就算欠下一日活。

pairs.target: nǚrén zài pángbiān bǎ zhè jù chóngfù le yìhuí , huǒjì diǎntóu , jiāng zhuōshàng de liùméi qián tuī jìn , méi náxià yìkǔn jìnwū , xiānbào zhe lǐ hǎo de sānshù chūqù .
pairs.english: The woman repeated this remark once beside him; the worker nodded, pushed the six coins on the table closer, and without bringing the next bundle inside, first carried the three sorted bundles out.
pairs.hanzi: 女人在旁边把这句重复了一回，伙计点头，将桌上的六枚钱推近，没拿下一捆进屋，先抱着理好的三束出去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi děng jiǎobù guò le yuànmén cái zuò jìn xiē , huò chéng jiāng qián lǒng dào zhǎng lǐ , yòu yìméi méi tānkāi , qīzi shuō zhèhuí zǒng búhuì shǔchū dìqī méi lái .
pairs.english: Tavi waited for the footsteps to pass the courtyard gate before sitting closer; Huo Cheng gathered the money into his palm, then spread each coin out again; his wife said surely he would not count a seventh one this time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维等脚步过了院门才坐近些，霍成将钱拢到掌里，又一枚枚摊开，妻子说这回总不会数出第七枚来。

pairs.target: tā jiāng qízhōng yìméi bō dào tā nàbiān , shuō shǎodiào cái yào zhǎo , nǚrén ná le qián , què méishōu lìngwài wǔméi , jiào tā zìjǐ fàng hǎo , bié hùn zài shéng tóulǐ .
pairs.english: He slid one of them toward her, saying he would look only if one went missing; the woman took that coin but left the other five, telling him to put them away himself rather than mix them with rope ends.
pairs.hanzi: 他将其中一枚拨到她那边，说少掉才要找，女人拿了钱，却没收另外五枚，叫他自己放好，别混在绳头里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàng zhe nàxiē qián , xiǎng shuō zhōngyú néng zuòshì le , huàdàozuǐbiān yòu yàn huíqù , huò chéng qiánjǐrì jiù huì zuò , chà de búshì liǎngzhīshǒu hūrán zhǎng hǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi watched the money, wanting to say he could finally work; the words reached his lips and were swallowed again; Huo Cheng could do it days earlier, and the missing thing had not been his two hands suddenly healing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维望着那些钱，想说终于能做事了，话到嘴边又咽回去，霍成前几日就会做，差的不是两只手忽然长好。

pairs.target: huò chéngjiàn tā kànzhe , wèn yào buyào zài bǎng nàge jié , tǎ wéi yáotóu shuō jīnrì xiān bù bǎng , zìjǐ zhǐ xiǎng zhīdào lǐ yìkǔn yào zuò duōjiǔ .
pairs.english: Seeing him watch, Huo Cheng asked whether he wanted to tie that knot again; Tavi shook his head, saying not today for now, he only wanted to know how long sorting a bundle meant sitting.
pairs.hanzi: 霍成见他看着，问要不要再绑那个结，塔维摇头说今日先不绑，自己只想知道理一捆要坐多久。

pairs.target: " zuò jiǔ le yě děi tíng . "
pairs.english: “Even after sitting a long time, you must stop.”
pairs.hanzi: “坐久了也得停。”

pairs.target: huò chéng jiāng bǎn wǎng pángbiān tuī yìdiǎn , lùchū chuángyán mó hóng de yíchù bù , shuō yāo búshì jièlái de , lèi le búhuì tì zìjǐ lìng zhǎo gèrén lái zuò .
pairs.english: Huo Cheng pushed the board a little aside, exposing a patch of cloth rubbed red at the bed's edge, saying his back was not borrowed; when tired, it would not find someone else to sit for him.
pairs.hanzi: 霍成将板往旁边推一点，露出床沿磨红的一处布，说腰不是借来的，累了不会替自己另找个人来坐。

pairs.target: qīzi duān lái yìwǎn wēnshuǐ , jiào tā zhèhuí zhēn tíng , bié zuǐlǐ shuō de míngbái , shǒushàng yòu qù jiǎn nàgēn xì de , huò chéng kàn tā yìyǎn , jiāng shǒu gē dào xī páng .
pairs.english: His wife brought a bowl of warm water, telling him to truly stop this time, rather than speak clearly while his hand went to pick up that thin strand again; Huo Cheng looked at her once and rested his hands beside his knees.
pairs.hanzi: 妻子端来一碗温水，叫他这回真停，别嘴里说得明白，手上又去捡那根细的，霍成看她一眼，将手搁到膝旁。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ de xī hái bùnéng shēn wān , zuórì liàn wán yǎnlǐ lèi , shǒu dào méi dùn , huò chéng shuō nà jiù bié náshǒu hǎohǎo de qù tóng tuǐ zhēng , búshì zhèlǐ hǎo yìdiǎn nàlǐ biàn děi gēnshàng .
pairs.english: Tavi said his knee still could not bend deeply, after practice yesterday his eyes were tired though his hands stayed clear; Huo Cheng said then not even to pit sound hands against a leg, as though one place improving a little meant the other must catch up.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己的膝还不能深弯，昨日练完眼里累，手倒没钝，霍成说那就别拿手好好的去同腿争，不是这里好一点那里便得跟上。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu wèn xuégōng héshí ràng tǎ wéi chūqù , tǎ wéi yě méiyǒu jiāng táng ruì yǐjīng zǒu le shuō chéng zìjǐ bèi liúzài hòutou , zhǐ shuō nài lěi hái zài chénglǐ .
pairs.english: He did not ask when the academy would let Tavi go out; Tavi did not turn Tang Rui's departure into being left behind himself either, only saying Nerai was still in the city.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有问学宫何时让塔维出去，塔维也没有将唐芮已经走了说成自己被留在后头，只说奈蕾还在城里。

pairs.target: nǚrén wèn nài lěi shǒu zěnyàng , tā zhào qián huíjiàn tā shí de yàngzi shuō , xiǎozhǐ háishì màn , néng ná zhǐ , què hái bú shàngchē , liǎng rén dōu méiyǒu jiē yíjù kànqǐlái yǐjīng hǎo le .
pairs.english: The woman asked how Nerai's hand was; he described how she had looked last time he saw her: the little finger still slow, able to hold paper but not boarding yet; neither person added that it looked healed already.
pairs.hanzi: 女人问奈蕾手怎样，他照前回见她时的样子说，小指还是慢，能拿纸，却还不上车，两人都没有接一句看起来已经好了。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ yǒu xiǎohái zhuī zhe yìzhī kōngzhú quān pǎo , zhú quān zhuàng dào ménbiān , huò chéng táitóu jiào mànxiē , qīzi zǒu chūqù shíqǐ , méi ràng háizi jìnwū jiǎn .
pairs.english: In the courtyard a child ran after an empty bamboo hoop; the hoop struck the doorway, Huo Cheng looked up and called for care, and his wife went out to pick it up, not letting the child come inside for it.
pairs.hanzi: 院里有小孩追着一只空竹圈跑，竹圈撞到门边，霍成抬头叫慢些，妻子走出去拾起，没让孩子进屋捡。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě qǐshēn ràngkāi ménkǒu , háizi wèn lǐtou shìbushì xiū shéng de , huò chéng zài wūlǐ tīngjiàn le , gé le yíhuìer cái dá , shì lǐ shéng de , bù xiū làndiào de .
pairs.english: Tavi also rose to clear the doorway; the child asked whether someone inside repaired rope; Huo Cheng heard from the room and only answered after a while: he sorted rope, not repaired rotten lengths.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也起身让开门口，孩子问里头是不是修绳的，霍成在屋里听见了，隔了一会儿才答，是理绳的，不修烂掉的。

pairs.target: xiǎohái tīngbùchū chābié , jiēguò zhú quān biàn zǒu , nǚrén huíwū shí hái xiào zhe , wèn shìbushì yě gāi zài ménshàng guà kuài pái , shěngde rénrén lái tǎo shéng .
pairs.english: The child could not hear the difference, took the bamboo hoop and left; the woman was still smiling on returning, asking whether they should also hang a sign on the door to save everyone coming for rope.
pairs.hanzi: 小孩听不出差别，接过竹圈便走，女人回屋时还笑着，问是不是也该在门上挂块牌，省得人人来讨绳。

pairs.target: huò chéng shuō pái yào shōuqián , tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ huà de bùhǎo , sāngè rén shuōwán dōu méi dòng , nà liùméi lǐ shèngxià de wǔméi réng zài huò chéng zhǎng xīnlǐ .
pairs.english: Huo Cheng said the sign would cost money; Tavi said his drawing was poor; none of the three moved after speaking, and the five remaining from those six coins were still in Huo Cheng's palm.
pairs.hanzi: 霍成说牌要收钱，塔维说自己画得不好，三个人说完都没动，那六枚里剩下的五枚仍在霍成掌心里。

pairs.target: tā zuìhòu jiāng qián shōu jìn zhěnbiān de xiǎodài , shǒu sōngkāi hòu zhǎng lǐ liú zhe jǐdào yuán yìn , tǎ wéi kàn le yìyǎn , cái bǎ dèng tuīhuí qiángbiān .
pairs.english: Finally he put the money into the small bag beside his pillow; when his hand opened, several round marks remained in his palm; Tavi looked once before pushing the stool back to the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 他最后将钱收进枕边的小袋，手松开后掌里留着几道圆印，塔维看了一眼，才把凳推回墙边。

pairs.target: chūménshí , tā méi tì huò chéng ná kōngxiàlái de kuān bǎn , nǚrén yào bǎ tā nuó qù chīfàn , huò chéng xiān shēnshǒu ànzhù , shuō wǎn fàngshànglái biànshì , zìjǐ jīnrì hái méi chī gòu .
pairs.english: As he left, he did not carry the cleared wide board for Huo Cheng; the woman wanted to move it for the meal, but Huo Cheng first reached to hold it down, saying to put the bowl on it: he had not eaten enough today yet.
pairs.hanzi: 出门时，他没替霍成拿空下来的宽板，女人要把它挪去吃饭，霍成先伸手按住，说碗放上来便是，自己今日还没吃够。
